outcome: Index of neuronal apoptosis in the cerebrum of newly born Rattus norvegicus
Index of neuronal apoptosis in the cerebellum of newly born Rattus norvegicus
cohort: Pregnant female Rattus norvegicus and their newly born offspring, divided into 5 groups.
finding: The apoptosis index of cerebrum neuron cells and the cerebellum of newly born Rattus norvegicus exposed to Mozart's music was lower than those exposed to Javanese, Sundanese, and Balinese gamelan music.
